lesson.notes: পাঠ 39 ব্যঞ্জনবর্ণ built. TRIVIAL RETAIN (পুনরালোচনা/স্ব-মূল্যায়ন): full 39-consonant review chart (p55) + বর্ণ সাজিয়ে লিখি ordering exercise (p56, 25 shuffled coloured tiles + blank write-boxes). ALL content verbatim, no edits. NO living beings, NO image slot, no C-code (S0). Chart/tiles are protected decoding-spine (README 4.5). All glyphs taught @39 (cumulative 50 consonants); grid/tiles are vector-native, not decodable prose (letter-chart type). block audit trivially clean + seeded self-test PASS.
